metadata.scenario_context: A group of international software firms are partnering on a development venture and have agreed to schedule a coordination meeting in mid-September to evaluate their progress so far.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Morocco agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose holding the meeting on the September 15.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sophie
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Levi, have we thought about the date for the coordination meeting yet? I was thinking... September 15 could work really well. What do you think? 

Also, I’ve been curious about your view on having the army rule. I mean, in Canada, we generally disagree with that. What’s your take on it?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Levi
shared_prefix.message:
September 15 sounds good, I think we should finalize that. It's important to have clarity moving forward. 

As for the army rule... well, in Morocco, it's widely viewed as bad. It just doesn’t align with the values of freedom and democracy that many people strive for. I appreciate your perspective from Canada, but it's a pretty different context for us.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sophie
shared_prefix.message:
I totally get that, Levi. It's interesting how we see things from different perspectives, but deep down, we are all the same. I think we can agree that people are pretty much motivated by the same things, like wanting freedom and a safe environment. It’s just that the context can shape our views. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us. I appreciate you sharing your perspective! 

So, shall we finalize the meeting for September 15 then?
